description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, which provides methods to interact with notes stored in a local SQLite database. It enables listing, creating, updating, and deleting notes within the app.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing note data, interfacing with the application's database layer to perform CRUD operations.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes from the database, optionally filtering by a search term and prioritizing pinned notes.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the given title, body, and pinned status, then inserts it into the database.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database. Throws an error if the note does not have an id.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database based on its id.
